caption: An imported newsletter body in Markdown.
eval: (async()=>{window.__q15Modal?.close();await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:'Substack Export Import/October export/101.first-post.md',mode:'preview'}}); const end=Date.now()+3000;let h;while(!h&&Date.now()<end){h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.markdown-preview-view h1')].find(x=>x.textContent==='A notebook for field notes');if(!h)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}h?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return 'ok';})()

caption: A podcast note keeps its type, date, publication state and CSV audio URL.
The report names the missing source ID and the orphan HTML member.
A Pro profile keeps custom property names and an output folder path.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['substack-export-import'];p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'fixture-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}});app.secretStorage.setSecret('substack-export-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36));await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.saveProfile({name:'Field notes publication',folder:'Substack Export Import/Next export',mapping:{title:'headline',subtitle:'deck',post_date:'post_date',published:'published',audience:'audience',type:'type',podcast_url:'podcast_url'}});window.__q15Modal?.close();const m=p.openImport();window.__q15Modal=m;m.folder='Substack Export Import/Next export';m.mapping=p.loadProfile('Field notes publication').mapping;m.loadBytes(Uint8Array.from(atob(''), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));m.contentEl.querySelector('details').open=true;m.contentEl.querySelector('.substack-import-result').remove();const h=[...m.contentEl.querySelectorAll('.setting-item')].find(r=>r.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==='Field mapping and folder profiles (Pro)');h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro shows the previous and new Markdown bodies for the changed post.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['substack-export-import'];p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'fixture-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}});app.secretStorage.setSecret('substack-export-import-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36));await p.pro.refreshNow();window.__q15Modal?.close();const m=p.openImport();window.__q15Modal=m;m.folder='Substack Export Import/Next export';m.loadBytes(Uint8Array.from(atob(''), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));const row=[...m.contentEl.querySelectorAll('.setting-item')].find(r=>r.querySelector('.setting-item-name')?.textContent==='Previous import folder');const input=row.querySelector('input');input.value='Substack Export Import/October export';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));row.querySelector('button').click();const end=Date.now()+5000;while(!m.contentEl.querySelector('.substack-import-changes details')&&Date.now()<end)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));const detail=m.contentEl.querySelector('.substack-import-changes details');if(!detail)throw Error('Comparison did not finish');detail.open=true;m.contentEl.querySelector('.substack-import-changes').scrollIntoView(); return 'ok';})()
